Never query tx_zoning_district_staging's geometry column without a city_key restriction or a bbox pre-filter on the polygon side -- the table holds ~107 cities' worth of ArcGIS polygons stored as JSONB, cast per-row via ST_GeomFromGeoJSON with no spatial index, so an unrestricted nested-loop spatial join has no cheap early-out and can hang rather than merely run slowly (this session: 1h05m at ~0% CPU before being killed). Always set statement_timeout and connect_timeout on ad hoc PostGIS sessions against this store, and announce the scan per AGENT_CONTRACT section 4 BEFORE running it, not after it stalls.

A flat JOIN between an 'in-city parcel list' and a multi-row-per-parcel geometry table (txgio_parcel) inflates denominator counts silently -- caught here only because DEV_PROCESS rule 1.4 (two numbers that should agree and don't) flagged denom_with_geom exceeding denom_incity, an impossible result, before it was reported anywhere. Any future residue/coverage measurement against txgio_parcel should aggregate per parcel from the start.
